messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "10 mg orally after 48 hours"
set: ["10 mg orally after 48 hours", "5 mg orally after 24 hours", "10 mg orally once a day", "8 mg orally every 8 hours after the first dose", "10 mg", "initial dose 10 mg orally once a day", "10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "5 to 10 mg orally once a day", "2.5 to 10 mg orally once a day", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "10 mg tablet", "Zepbound 10 mg", "Mounjaro 10 mg", "50 mg every 6 hours for 48 hours, starting 15 minutes after the last dose given into a vein", "8 mg orally 1 to 2 hours before radiotherapy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
